senses.gloss: (read אַנְדְּרוֹלֵימְסְיָא), אַנְדְּרוֹלֵמְסְיָה f. (popular pronunc. of ἀνδρολημψία = ἀνδροληψία; cmp. λῆμψις for λῆψις) seizure of men, a Greek right of reprisals (v. Sm. Ant. s. v.), in gen. punishment of men regardless of guilt or innocence.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 26:5">Gen. R. s. 26</cite> <he>א׳ באה וכ׳</he> an androlepsia comes which kills the good and the bad; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 23">Lev. <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 5:3">Num. R. s. 5</cite> in case of a rebellion <he>עוש׳ בה א׳</he> the king orders an androlepsia. [<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 32">Gen.
